row: Spirit Keeper Animal Sanctuary is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit animal welfare organization dedicated to providing lifelong sanctuary for animals with special medical, behavioral, and welfare needs. We care for horses, snakes, dogs, cats, and other companion animals who have been neglected, abused, relinquished, or require specialized long-term care that makes placement difficult. Our mission extends beyond rescue. Through science-based behavioral husbandry, positive welfare practices, education, and community outreach, we strive to help every animal experience a life well lived while inspiring compassionate, evidence-based care for animals everywhere. Our journey began as a safe haven for horses in need of lifetime sanctuary and has grown into an organization able to offer those same services across species, specializing in unique veterinary, behavioral, and nutritional needs.
